item.title: Foundations and Vision of General Plastic Industrial Co., Ltd.
item.description:
Company Overview
#

General Plastic Industrial Co., Ltd. (GPI) is a leading manufacturer specializing in imaging supplies. Established in 1978, GPI is headquartered at 50, Tzu-Chiang Rd., Wu-Chi District, Taichung City, Taiwan 43546. With a workforce of over 500 employees, the company reported a revenue of 60 million US dollars as of December 31, 2017.
